::: {#def-racket-define}
#### Defining a function in Racket

The Racket definition

```racket
(define (f x1 ... xn)
  body)
```

defines a function named `f` with **parameters** `x1`, ..., `xn`:
names that stand for its arguments (@def-argument).
To evaluate an application `(f a1 ... an)`,
Racket evaluates the arguments `a1`, ..., `an`,
replaces each parameter in `body` by the value of its argument,
and evaluates the result.
The value of the application is the value (@def-value) of `f` at those arguments.

:::
